name: Small bottom-feeding fish
description: Small benthic-feeding fish - the source's Gerres compartment (two mojarras, or silverbellies), its Pomadasys compartment (three grunts) and its 'Petits benthophages' compartment (a blenny, a goby, a puffer, a seahorse and a pipefish): small-mouthed pickers over meiobenthos, macrobenthos and shrimps. Functional group pooling those three source compartments to fit this atlas's 25-node ceiling.
